Primary (10 minutes): 1d6 Humanity Loss on the dose (returned if you avoid the Secondary). Once a Round, spend an Action or Move Action to look through the hallucinations and get a true hint from the GM about someone or something in the scene. NPCs on Glitter can do it to you. Secondary (DV19): addicted; without a dose, INT and TECH −2 (min 1) and Base Death Save +1.

Cost: 100eb

Item Compendium (2070) • Drugs
